text:
violet: Quick thought  tiny experiment for reactivating dormant signups: 'reactivate+craft'  grant 80 tokens + a 3-step prompt workshop in-console. Aim: get them to ship a saved prompt in 72h.

ryan: Love the workshop idea. How do we define dormant?

violet: Dormant = signed up >7 days ago, made at least one API call, but no saved prompts and no billing. Exclude enterprise and recent promo users.

kai: Suggested arms: control, tokens-only (80), tokens+workshop, tokens+workshop+followup-email. Randomize at user level, track within 72h.

harper: Workshop flow = 3 steps built in-console: pick use case, fill 2 example inputs, save & test. We show live preview and one-click save. If they save, auto-credit extra 40 tokens.

ryan: Good. Primary metric = saved_prompt within 72h. Secondary = gen_calls after save, retention 7d. Sample size estimate = ~6k to detect a 3pp lift.

kai: Backend: reuse /exp/grant with exp_id=exp-2026-08-reactivate-craft. Payload small, idempotent. Fallback: promo code via email when grant fails.

violet: Comms: short in-console modal + optional email for workshop arms. Email subject variants: A) "80 tokens + a 3-step workshop to build your first prompt" B) "Quick workshop: build a prompt in 60s (we added tokens)"

harper: Microcopy for modal: "Build a prompt that fits your data. 80 tokens to try it out." Button variants: "Start workshop" vs "Claim tokens". I'll prototype. :art: 

sarah-sales: Routing: if user saves & fires >15 gens in 48h, mark hot and post to Sales with `source=reactivate-craft`. Include `company_size` and `top_use_case`. SDRs will triage.

growth-bot: Experiment created: id=exp-2026-08-reactivate-craft, start=1778133600, end=1778333600, arms=4. Tracking channel #growth-experiments.

ryan: Analytics: add `exp_id` and `arm` to events. I'll create a dashboard for daily redemption rate, save rate, lift vs control, and cost-per-incremental-activation.

violet: Guardrails: per-org token cap 300, exclude users who used promo in last 30d, and pause if daily_experiment_spend_cap hits $350.

harper: UX note: show confetti + quick tip after save and surface the extra 40-token bonus. Also include a 1-question survey on the save modal: "What's your goal?" (options: assistant, content, search).

kai: Edge case: multi-account users. We'll randomize by account_id and check for cross-assignments. Also ensure not overlapping with other active experiments.

ryan: Measurement plan: interim check at day 3 for redemption and save lift; full analysis at day 14. Include subgroup by region and initial activity level.

sarah-sales: For hot leads, include `recent_usage_score` and `trial_status` in webhook payload so SDRs know whether to prioritize.

violet: Timeline: mock & copy by EOD, backend + QA by Wed, pilot launch next Mon. Can we hit that?

kai: Yes. I'll schedule QA and add idempotency tests.

harper: Posting prototypes in #marketing-drafts shortly. Will include 2 CTA variants.

violet: Thanks all  tagging @ryan @kai @harper @sarah-sales. If any promo conflicts, flag here. Check-in Fri. :calendar:
